gloss: at last; finally; barely; with difficulty

definitions.explanation: After a long wait or process, something has happened.
Managing to do something but only just, with much effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧、{漸|ようや}く⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After three years, I finally graduated.

examples.japanese: {漸|ようや}く⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格：02816_goukaku⟧。
{漸|ようや}く⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
{漸|ようや}く⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{漸|ようや}く⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I barely made it in time.

examples.japanese: {漸|ようや}く⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{漸|ようや}く⟦{歩|ある}ける→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ように→よう：01114_you⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I finally became able to walk.

notes:
{漸|ようや}く is an adverb expressing that something happened after a long time or with difficulty.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {漸|ようや}く⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ (finally finished)
- {漸|ようや}く⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (finally understood)
- {漸|ようや}く⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (finally obtained)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {漸|ようや}く vs. ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧: Very similar. ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧ is more colloquial and often emphasizes relief or barely managing. {漸|ようや}く can be slightly more literary.
- {漸|ようや}く vs. ⟦{遂|つい}に→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧: ⟦{遂|つい}に→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧ emphasizes the culmination of events ("at last, in the end"), often for dramatic or significant events. {漸|ようや}く emphasizes the long process or difficulty.
- {漸|ようや}く vs. ⟦とうとう→とうとう：00900_toutou⟧: ⟦とうとう→とうとう：00900_toutou⟧ can have either positive or negative connotation for something that finally happened after a long process.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana as ようやく. The kanji {漸} is rarely used in everyday writing.

Register: Neutral to slightly formal.
